name: Mochizuki Akira
source:
A beautiful young man who suggested Yuki to get her revenge on Reiji when she was at the height of despair. He even helps her become a "Reiji's type"; a beautiful, sexy woman. Yuki doesn't know why he wishes to help her so much...

[Based on translations of his official website profile.]
translation:
一名美丽的年轻男子。在雪最绝望时，他建议雪向怜司复仇，甚至帮助她变成“怜司喜欢的类型”——美丽性感的女人。雪不知道他为何如此热心地帮助自己……

[根据官方网站人物简介的译文整理。]
